In this video we explore liquid clustering in Delta tables, compare it with traditional partitioning, and discuss the pros and cons of each approach. You'll see live demos in Databricks that illustrate how both techniques organize data, how they affect query performance, and when to choose one over the other.
What you will learn:
• How partitioning creates directory‑based folders for each column value
• How liquid clustering organizes files intelligently without extra folders
• Steps to create and query both partitioned and liquid‑clustered Delta tables
